The filing places data-center and computing-equipment cooling inside the company's principal business and lists an end-to-end liquid-cooling portfolio including cold plates, quick connectors, manifolds, CDU, cabinets, coolant, piping, and cooling sources. Machine-room temperature-control products generated about RMB 3.448 billion, or 56.83% of company revenue. Liquid cooling is included in this broader product family but is not separately disclosed, so exact liquid-cooling revenue remains undisclosed. The filing identifies evaporative cooling, phase-change cooling, and liquid-cooling products for data-service customers and lists major internet, colocation, server, and cloud-computing customers. The filing treats data services as a reporting business segment and reports 43.77% year-on-year growth for the segment, but does not isolate AI-data-center liquid-cooling revenue. The filing states that thermal-management products have expanded into information and communications and high-power-density equipment, including cooling products used in data-center-related scenarios. Data-center and information-communication cooling are disclosed applications within the company's thermal-management business, but revenue for the AI-data-center subset is not separately disclosed. The filing states that the company supplies cold-source equipment and heat-exchange devices to data centers and describes data-center-specific chiller and cooling products. Data-center cooling is an identified growth application inside the broader industrial refrigeration and HVAC business; data-center-only revenue is not separately disclosed.
